mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, round_number, state, participant_count, completed_participants, gradient_uploads_received, model_broadcasts_acked, dataset_bindings, started_at, completed_at, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM round_states WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND round_number = #{roundNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO round_states ( task_id, round_number, state, participant_count, completed_participants, gradient_uploads_received, model_broadcasts_acked, dataset_bindings, started_at, completed_at, error_message ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{roundNumber}, #{state}, #{participantCount}, #{completedParticipants}, #{gradientUploadsReceived}, #{modelBroadcastsAcked}, #{datasetBindings}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE round_states
state = #{state},
started_at = #{startedAt},
completed_at = #{completedAt},
error_message = #{errorMessage},
updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND round_number = #{roundNumber}

UPDATE round_states
participant_count = #{participantCount},
completed_participants = #{completedParticipants},
gradient_uploads_received = #{gradientUploadsReceived},
model_broadcasts_acked = #{modelBroadcastsAcked},
updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND round_number = #{roundNumber}
